sbar.situation: The bank is recovered. Payments accept transfers again and clearing is running, confirmed by one clean recovery check at 13 s.
sbar.background: About 12 s before detection, a pipeline config change set payments max_transfer_minor from 1000000 to 1, so 73% of requests were rejected with 422 'amount exceeds transfer limit'. About 14 s before detection, clearing crashed (exit code 1) with a JSONDecodeError while parsing item 85, which blocked the clearing queue.
sbar.assessment: The incident commander reverted payments max_transfer_minor to 1000000, quarantined clearing item 85 for the operations team, and restarted clearing; all three actions succeeded. The root causes were the bad config (confidence 0.95) and item 85 as a poison message (confidence 0.88); the screening-standby restarts were routine maintenance.
sbar.recommendation: Find out why the pipeline set max_transfer_minor to 1 and stop it from being reapplied. The operations team has been asked (soon) to review quarantined clearing item 85 and either repair and resubmit it or close it with its customer, and to review the payments rejected by the bad limit.
